name: Duxer Alm
kurzbeschreibung: **Duxer Alm** is a picturesque alpine meadow near **Kufstein**, nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. Here, you can enjoy breathtaking views of the **Kaisergebirge** mountain range while indulging in traditional Tyrolean hospitality. The rustic hut serves up hearty dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsekrainer**, and fresh milk straight from the cow. Whether you're hiking, relaxing, or simply soaking in the crisp mountain air, **Duxer Alm** offers an authentic taste of alpine life.
